milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The dark_oak_button is placed at spawn-relative position (3, 2, 6) on the exterior west wall of the dark oak structure. The player must navigate close enough and face toward the button to confirm they have found it. max_distance=5 is used because the structure is only ~3 blocks from spawn and the button is subtle (dark oak on dark oak), so the player needs to be relatively close to actually see it. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking in the button's direction.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a trapdoor from 6 dark_oak_planks produces dark_oak_trapdoor items that end up in the player's inventory. The chest contains exactly 6 dark_oak_planks, and the 3x3 crafting recipe (2 rows of 3 planks) yields 2 dark_oak_trapdoors. Only 1 is required as min_count to be lenient. The player starts with no trapdoors, so any dark_oak_trapdoor in inventory confirms the craft was completed. inventory_has is preferred over craft_item event tracking because the crafted item reliably ends up in inventory.
